# Gramlot 0.2.19

- Add `html_button` as a distinct Source element that renders a plain native HTML button. It preserves submit/reset and explicit event handling without Gramlot button dispatch or an implicit type.
- Keep `button` as the Gramlot behavior-bearing button. Add inherited `_delay` in milliseconds: rapid clicks restart the wait and produce one execution with the last event and the burst count. Actions/fire receive `_counter`; nested controllers/RPC receive `button_counter`.
- Apply the delay before ask and the selected click mechanism. Cancel pending work on Source removal, disposal or DOM detachment. Preserve immediate-click behavior and the single-mechanism rule.
- Document the distinction and legacy differences. Companion examples add action/ask, conditional confirmation, Source/DOM references and comparisons between plain, immediate and delayed buttons.

Verified with 608 core JavaScript tests, 137 Python tests and focused native-button/dialog/lifecycle checks. New examples passed Chromium and WebKit on Python and Node hosts and as direct-file serverless exports. Strict documentation builds and links passed. No separate Safari-app or Firefox qualification is claimed. The legacy 200 ms immediate-click disabled guard is not introduced.
